import json,time,numpy as np,mpmath as mp
from pathlib import Path
from physical_alpha0226_midpoint_operator import Alpha0226Midpoint
mp.iv.dps=40
t=time.time(); model=Alpha0226Midpoint(jets=False)
def upper(x): return np.nextafter(float(x.b),np.inf)
def interval(z): return mp.iv.mpc(float(z.real),float(z.imag))
def certify(s):
    y=np.linalg.inv(s); n=s.shape[0]
    si=[[interval(z) for z in row] for row in s]; yi=[[interval(z) for z in row] for row in y]
    row=[mp.iv.mpf(0) for _ in range(n)]; col=[mp.iv.mpf(0) for _ in range(n)]
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(n):
            e=mp.iv.mpc(int(i==j))-sum((yi[i][k]*si[k][j] for k in range(n)),mp.iv.mpc(0))
            row[i]+=abs(e); col[j]+=abs(e)
    eb=mp.iv.sqrt(max(upper(v) for v in row)*max(upper(v) for v in col))
    yr=max(upper(sum((abs(z) for z in r),mp.iv.mpf(0))) for r in yi)
    yc=max(upper(sum((abs(yi[i][j]) for i in range(n)),mp.iv.mpf(0))) for j in range(n))
    yb=mp.iv.sqrt(mp.iv.mpf(yr)*mp.iv.mpf(yc))
    lower=(1-eb)/yb
    return dict(inverse_residual_spectral_upper=upper(eb),inverse_norm_spectral_upper=upper(yb),singular_min_lower=np.nextafter(float(lower.a),-np.inf))
parts=model.factors[0]; receipts=[certify(p['SF']) for p in parts[:2]]
a=mp.iv.mpf(float(model.weights[0]))*mp.iv.mpf(receipts[0]['singular_min_lower'])**2*mp.iv.mpf(receipts[1]['singular_min_lower'])**4
out=dict(exact_byte_operator_alpha_lower=np.nextafter(float(a.a),-np.inf),receipts=receipts,weight=float(model.weights[0]),elapsed_seconds=time.time()-t,interpretation='Outward mp.iv bound on exact represented double SF/weight bytes; SINGLE positive Haar node, COMPLETE Gauss restriction. Does not certify underlying transcendental SF generation or continuous Haar.')
print(json.dumps(out))
